name: mod-claude
description: Claude Code mods for CLI users: context HUD, agents pane, session map, and a blast-radius guard

plugins.name: agents-side
plugins.description: Live tree of the main loop and its subagents, docked beside the transcript

plugins.name: context-board
plugins.description: Compact context card plus a kit strip of loaded skills, agents, CLAUDE.md, and plugins

plugins.name: session-map
plugins.description: Live pane of files Claude read, edited, or wrote this session, grouped by app

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky Bash (migrations, force-push, DROP, hard reset) until you Proceed or Cancel
